description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Makes a PUBLIC review link for a campaign: a page, open to anyone who holds the link with no login, that shows the brand's drafts carrying `campaignLabel` (e.g. `campaign:<campaign id>`) and lets the reviewer approve or ask for changes. `expiresInDays` is one of `expiryDays` from list_campaign_shares. Give `site` and `requester` together to add the line "Made by flayr from the public pages of <site> for <requester>", or leave both out. The answer has `url` and `token` ONCE (flayr stores only a hash): give the user the `url` right away. `brandId` from list_brands (a brand-bound connection may omit it).
(Wraps POST /api/v2/campaign-shares.)

brandId.description: Brand id (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key uses its own brand.

campaignLabel.description: The label on the drafts to show, e.g. `campaign:<campaign id>`. At least one draft of the brand must carry it.

requester.description: Who the campaign was made for: a name, no links. Give it with `site`.

site.description: The public site the campaign was made from (example.com or a full address; stored as the host name). Give it with `requester`.

title.description: The heading of the public page.

name: create_campaign_share
title: Share a campaign for review
